What's inside

Twenty vendors, one roof

Daisy's isn't one shop — it's twenty of them, each with its own booth and its own eye. Tap a shelf to see what's on it.

    • Painted side tables & drop-leaf tables
    • School-room globes
    • Mantel clocks
    • Vintage children's books
    • Mirrors, frames & wall art
    • Glassware, crocks & kitchen tins
    • Printed tees — seasonal & back-to-school designs
    • Custom hats
    • Engraved & personalized pieces
    • Book bundles — vintage readers & picture books
    • Writing bundles — pencils, notebooks, desk bits
    • Art bundles
    • Cards & stationery
    • Hi Line Honey — local, by the jar
    • Lip balm
    • Seasonal & holiday decor
    • Toys & snacks for small shoppers

Booths change as vendors bring new finds in — what's here this week may be gone the next. Daisy's is always looking for new vendors, too.

Our story

Open since May 2025

A women-owned shop on Corrin Avenue that gave twenty local vendors a place to put their finds.

Daisy's opened in the spring of 2025 with a simple idea: one room in downtown Orting where the people who hunt estate sales, refinish furniture, print shirts and bottle honey could all set up next to each other. The result is a shop that changes week to week, because twenty different people are deciding what goes in it.

It's built for wandering, and for wandering with a stroller — there are toys and snacks for small shoppers, clean bathrooms with changing tables, and somewhere in one of the rooms, a taxidermy goose that children reliably find before their parents do.
